Hi Marco,

Thanks for sending the draft order form. Before we can finalize, our legal and procurement teams need clarification on a few insurance items in the order form and MSA crosswalk. Specific asks below — can you confirm these with your broker and insurer?

1) Additional Insured naming: we need the endorsement to name exactly: "Redwood Inference, Inc.; Redwood Inference Holdings, LLC; and their respective subsidiaries and affiliates". Please confirm insurer can endorse to that language.

2) Primary & non-contributory: insurer must confirm wording that coverage will be primary and non-contributory with respect to claims covered by the policy for services performed under the Order Form.

3) Retroactive date / prior acts: for Professional Liability/Errors & Omissions, confirm whether a retroactive date or prior-acts coverage is required/available and, if so, what date will be used. Our legal team has flagged this as important for any run-off exposure.

4) Aggregate limits: the order form calls for a $3M aggregate. Please confirm whether that is per policy period aggregate or a per-location/per-project aggregate — insurer schedule we received earlier was ambiguous.

5) Waiver of subrogation: confirm whether waiver of subrogation can be provided in favor of Redwood where permitted by law.

6) Certificates: request for an updated COI that references the Order Form number (ACME-4578) in the Description box and lists the required endorsements attached.

Can you loop in your broker if needed — I see broker@allianzbroker.com in the prior thread — and let us know an estimated timeline to issue the COI + endorsements? We have a target signature date of July 7.

If it helps, attaching our redline of the order form (orderform-ACME-#4578.pdf).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett

Thanks Marco — quick clarifications from legal:

- Endorsement text: please ask the carrier to confirm endorsement form and provide a PDF of the actual endorsement they will attach to the COI. We need to review the endorsement wording; a promise to "use best efforts" is insufficient.

- Additional insured scope: Redwood requires additional insured for claims arising out of AcmeTech's performance of services under the Order Form. Please ensure that the endorsement is not limited to vicarious liability only.

- If the carrier cannot provide retroactive coverage extension for E&O, please identify whether AcmeTech has a run-off policy option or whether the carrier is willing to issue an extended reporting period endorsement.

- If the $3M aggregate is policy-period only and the carrier cannot change that, we will evaluate whether an umbrella policy can provide the required drop-down/aggregate wording — ask the broker to outline the layered structure (primary GL, umbrella, E&O stacking).

I'll attach suggested redline language below for insertion into the Order Form (cut/paste friendly):

"Insurance. Supplier shall maintain insurance with the following minimum limits: Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $3,000,000 policy aggregate; Professional Liability: $2,000,000 per claim / $2,000,000 aggregate with retroactive date no later than January 1, 2019; Umbrella Liability: $3,000,000. Supplier's Commercial General Liability and Umbrella policies shall include Redwood Inference, Inc., Redwood Inference Holdings, LLC and their subsidiaries and affiliates as Additional Insureds with coverage for claims arising out of Supplier's performance under this Agreement, and shall be primary and non-contributory."

Please provide carrier response (endorsement PDF) and broker timeline.

-kim

Kimberly Park

Hi all — Allan from Allianz Broker here. Thanks for the specifics; we can do most of the items requested but will need the signed Order Form (ACME-4578) and the final naming string to generate the endorsement. Actions and timing below:

1) Endorsement PDF: we will prepare the actual AI endorsement draft for your review within 48 hours of receiving the signed order form.
2) Retroactive date: carrier confirms current retroactive date of 2019-01-01 for E&O on the existing policy. Extension of prior-acts coverage is not automatic; we can request an Extended Reporting Period (ERP) endorsement but that typically requires underwriting approval and may add cost.
3) Aggregate: current GL is a standard policy-period aggregate; to meet a contractually required per-project aggregate we usually recommend an umbrella placement with explicit drop-down language — we will outline options and costs in our quote.
4) COI: we can issue a COI referencing the Order Form number immediately; endorsements will follow once we have the signed order form + broker authorization.

Attaching our endorsement_request_form.pdf — please sign/return with the order form attached and we'll prioritize issuance.

Regards,
